name: ieee-skills
description: A collection of Claude-compatible academic workflow bundles for producing work at IEEE journal and conference standards. Covers scientific figures (ieee-figure), technical prose polishing (ieee-polishing), manuscript drafting (ieee-writing), peer-review assessment (ieee-reviewer), IEEE [1]-style citation retrieval and export (ieee-citation), data availability and reproducibility (ieee-data), paper-to-presentation conversion (ieee-paper2ppt), literature search via MCP (ieee-academic-search), paper reading and annotation (ieee-reader), and peer-review response drafting (ieee-response).
